facts.fact: 炼金日程：藤撕细条入沸水转淡 mauve（终将成 aubergine）；首萃后需两小时午光、静置、残月下三夜、再静置三周——「We're going to have a lot of downtime」；他的「很忙」承诺是 fortify wards（她 groan：他说得对）。
facts.anchor: We’re going to have a lot of downtime.

facts.fact: 海滩提议：pall 云罩不到 Atlantia——她想晒到从内而外暖；计划「本周做完 ward+大部分译文，下周六去海滩」；他说「I'd love to take you to the beach that Saturday, but we might have to take a break to watch a five-year-old pick flowers in the outfield. My nephew's baseball game is that day.」——她劝他改天，他坚持「Come to the game. Invite Dahlia. We'll have hot dogs and get irrationally angry at the opposing five-year-olds.」
facts.anchor: What if we just see how much we get done this week?

facts.fact: Dot 的餐馆：90 岁的 Dot 亲自接待 Arthur（「你见到了名人」）；外卖三明治里夹着她颤抖笔迹的餐巾——「What a hunk!」Maggie 呛到汤、藏进口袋（「Arthur 看到会 insufferable」）；两人换了午餐吃（他点了她最爱的姜香牛肉面——她偷走一块牛肉）。
沙发午休：一小时空白时段——两人各捧小说（他挑了本读过的奇幻、她读攒着的 romance）；毯子盖腿防窗缝寒气；他的手在她裙面画着越来越大的圈，指尖滑到皮肤——她合书起身反锁办公室门。
facts.anchor: She tossed a crocheted blanket over their legs

facts.fact: 办公室险情：她跨坐他腿上「You broke them first.」；「Whatever we start here we can't finish here. We have to check on the decoction in half an hour.」；他问「Is this okay?」——她以吻作答；他 moan「I am beginning to see the appeal of the fainting couch」；他从她裙袋里摸出 Dot 餐巾展开——「Dot seems to think you've done well for yourself」她尖叫「That's not your business!」被压制并躺倒。
facts.anchor: You’re breaking the rules,” he said through clenched teeth

facts.fact: 她的供词：被夸「所以你觉得我有魅力」「You know you are.」「Maybe. But I like to hear you say it.」——她供出「你的好看从 pall 落地那天就让我分神：你蠢头发、肩膀、小臂」；他吻住她的 rambling。
facts.anchor: Your good looks have been driving me to distraction since the day the pall fell

facts.fact: 迎新酒会记忆：他拇指擦过她被吻肿的下唇——「你那天穿的这条裙子。你朝我走来带着 lovely smile。那是我第一次注意到你的嘴唇、第一次想吻你是什么感觉」；「你没跟我套近乎、没问我的研究——你几乎只说了句 Hello, welcome 就回去跟 Dahlia 聊天」「You liked me because I was rude?」「Maybe. A little.」
facts.anchor: You were wearing this same skirt.

facts.fact: 十月讲座：他去听了她的 community lecture——「就是那时我爱上了你的思考方式」；会后去图书馆读了她已发表的研究；她笑骂「这可能是有人对我说过最性感的话——你最好不是骗我上床」；他便开始背诵——「Hand in hand, walking through eastern fields of gilded yarrow…Bury my body, love.」正是她的 Branagh's Aubade 译文——她感觉自己在 short-circuit。
facts.anchor: That’s when I fell in love with how you think.

facts.fact: 互换底牌：她问他真读了她的译文？「What you've published of it, yes. It's beautiful.」她坦白「I went to your community lecture, too.」「I was spectacularly annoyed that you were as brilliant as advertised.」「In all facets of life, she added, gasping.」他回「There is only one thing I care about being good at right now.」
facts.anchor: You read my translation of Branagh’s Aubade?

facts.fact: 收束：她提规则、他以 wicked voice 问「Are you sure you want me to remember the rules, Maggie?」——她 squirm 想弃守（门锁了、校园空了、暑期没课），计时器恰好响起——他早料到时间，最后一记慢抚与长吻收尾，起身回实验室。
